pattern: 抜きにして / 抜きで（ぬきにして/ ぬきで）
aliases: ぬきにして/ ぬきで
purpose: Leave something out of an action or discussion.
keywords: N + 抜きで / 抜きにして
Today I want to talk seriously, without jokes.
Could you make it without onions?
Even leaving the price aside, I like this shape.
formation: N + 抜きで / 抜きにして
restrictions: Can omit an ingredient, participant, procedure, or consideration.
mistake: 抜きにしても may mean even leaving that factor aside.
